title: Loyalty Program Software Pricing 2026: 16 Tools Compared

facts.fact: CostBench's Loyalty Program Software category page lists 16 products.
facts.quote: Compare pricing for 16 loyalty program software tools. Find the right software for your budget.

facts.fact: Across the 12 loyalty program software tools with listed monthly prices, the monthly range runs from $0 to $999 per month.
The median monthly price across the 12 loyalty program software tools with listed monthly prices is $207 per month, per CostBench.
Two of the 16 loyalty program software tools offer free tiers, according to CostBench.
facts.quote: 2 of 16 tools offer free tiers for small teams or limited use.

facts.fact: Antavo lists custom pricing rather than published monthly prices, per CostBench.
